title: 第5章 妖核之争
content_zh:
茂密的丛林，遮掩了山壁，太阳高挂，微风吹过，树影幢幢，显得几分阴森。

在一处杂草丛生的乱石堆中，黎晨猫着身子，缓缓前行，发梢下的眸子纵然是在白天，都似是有一抹亮光闪现。

小心的扫视了一下四周，并未因这里安静就掉以轻心，虽然他年轻，从未进过古苍山，但爷爷老黎头给他讲的故事可不少。

尤其是关于武者进入古苍山寻宝，因为掉以轻心而送命的事情。

自小因为丑陋胎记与无法凝聚内息的缘故，

死死盯着丈许远处，在一条岩石缝隙中，延伸出的一条筷子粗细，通体青色，浑身有着嫩黄小刺，不过尺许长的藤蔓。

在其嫩绿色的　叶片之上，有几滴露水轻颤，在上方光芒映照下，显得异常喜人。

“青刺藤，一阶上品灵药，上品聚息丹主药！”

脑海中划过藤蔓的信息，黎晨三年多至今的药奴生涯可不是白费，仔细的扫过藤蔓周围米许范围之内的土石，没有放过丝毫。

能够先他人一步发现灵药所在，不是靠的修为，而是多年做药奴，对药味的灵敏嗅觉。

蓦地瞳孔骤然一缩，一圈看似与周围土石无异，但明显连成片，身体如幼儿小臂粗细，长不过两尺的怪异妖蛇映入眼帘。

“土环蛇，一阶中期妖兽，重防御，剧毒，力量极大！”

在发现土环蛇之际，其蓦然吞吐猩红色蛇信，仰首向黎晨看来。

妖兽天生嗜杀，灵觉更是机敏，纵然黎晨按照老黎头教授的知识做到最好，但终究经验不足。

面对这连六层武者都心秫的一阶中级妖兽，黎晨有些退去，但想及老黎头速教，蛇类妖兽近距离攻击速度极为快捷，若是他稍有退势，必然会遭受土环蛇的雷霆噬咬。

虽然头皮发麻，但心下却另有一股兴奋传荡，黎晨小腿发力，动若脱兔，嗖的一声蹿起，双目中迸射出慑人精芒，经脉中达到五层的内息蓦然涌动灌注右臂，狠狠一拳砸向蛇躯脖颈。

那里是土环蛇要害，黎晨与信心，一拳崩碎其体内心脉，纵然生命力再强，也无济于事。

似是被黎晨举动惊了一下，但到底是在残酷环境下成长的妖兽，土环蛇张口嘶鸣，整个躯体绷直弹起，竟是绕过拳峰，闪电般向咽喉噬咬。

黎晨瞳孔骤然一缩，拳势不变，但却变拳为爪，早已大成乃至圆满的虎咆拳，拳掌变化收缩自如，兼之其所学乃是人阶高级功法《融阳诀》，至刚至阳，杀伤力更胜一筹。

指掌上的筋肉在内息加持下，隐隐有气浪划过，啪的一声将蹿来土环蛇抓住。

触手间宛若抓住了一根粗糙铁棍，土环蛇不过两尺，堪堪比黎晨手臂长一点，被抓住中下部，登时便向其肩头咬去。

黎晨整个手臂抡圆，不待其咬中，宛若风车般急速转动，一下一下的摔打着土环蛇，碎石飞溅砰砰作响。

足足过了盏茶工夫，感觉到土环蛇尾部缠绕自己的手腕力道松懈，身形一扭，狠狠的一脚踩住其头顶。

噌的一声轻响，寒芒闪过处，黎晨左手中蓦然多出了一柄银芒闪烁的匕首，忍着手臂之上传来的隐隐痛楚，将土环蛇死死按在地上，狠狠向其脖颈后面的青白色小点刺去。

刀锋入肉，溅起了一丝腥甜血气，被刺重要害的土环蛇，扭动了两下，便再没了动静。

堪比内息境六层武者的妖兽，交手两招便被杀，除了其本身灵智不高，除了毒性与防御之外无其他长处，兼之黎晨修炼的功法，乃至自身体质极强外，足以印证黎晨此时的实力，绝对强于一般的六层武者。

此时他的修为，经过夜里偷偷服用得来的聚息丹，已然突破到了五层。

只是那么多聚息丹，只是让黎晨在这几个月的苦练中突破到五层巅峰，却是让他有些小小气馁。

吭哧喘了口粗气，来不及擦去额头细汗，黎晨从背囊中取出一个玉瓶，拔出瓶塞，径直把蛇尸倒转。

跐溜一股暗红色蛇血，散发着热气尽数没入到小巧的玉瓶中，直至蛇血发红，黎晨这才将蛇尸放下，重新放入道背囊中。

做完这些，黎晨将蛇皮剥下，毒牙拔出，至于蛇肉则最终选择了放弃，血腥味太大，难免被人察觉。

若是让他人知晓，一向‘废物’如他，竟然能够猎杀一阶中期妖兽，绝对会引来不必要的麻烦。

受辱多年，这点隐忍的心思还是有的。

可惜的是，在蛇尸之上捏了捏，没有发现妖核的存在。

小心翼翼的将那青刺藤挖出，刚要休息一下，猛然起身向山林中一处奔去。

宛若灵猴般的身影，转瞬便消失在密林中。

刺耳的笛声从远处袭来，此起彼伏，若非黎晨耳力惊人，很可能将之漏过，亦或者听成某种妖兽的鸣叫。

密林内衣袂飘飘，黎晨不断向笛声响处疾掠。

当其再出现时，躲在两块巨石的缝隙中，向远处望去。

只见一片狼藉的灌木丛中，正有七八人手执兵刃之人，相互对峙，看衣着服饰，皆是玄云宗弟子，只不过明显分成两拨。

中间是一头伏倒在地的黑褐色妖猪，足有两米大小，周身密布血痕。

“你们东院之人，强抢我南院弟子的妖核，难道就不怕院主责罚？”

黎晨认得，名叫张福通的外门弟子，修为不过五层罢了。

其身后，赵珊珊搀扶着倒地不起的另一名少年，其胸口处一滩触目惊心的血渍，胸口微微起伏，身受重创。

此人名叫刘子清，是三人中修为最强者，内息境六层，却不想伤在这里。

许是黎晨离此地最近，竟是他先到此。

“这位师弟说的话就不中听了，这本来就是我们猎杀的妖兽，何来强抢之由？”

对面一名腰挎两柄短刀的少年，随手抛了抛手中龙眼大小的妖核，显然那妖猪是一头中期妖兽。

一颗中期妖核，足以比得上数颗中品聚息丹功效，对于外门弟子而言，再珍贵不过。

张福通被对方无耻的话语激的面红耳赤，兼之气势被夺，一时语塞。

“哼，陆鸿阳，我看你是皮痒了，敢欺负我师弟？”

嗵的一声巨响，一道胖大身影从远处巨石上跳下，飞速向此地掠来。
content_en:
The dense jungle covers the mountain wall, the sun is high, the breeze blows, and the shadows of the trees look a bit eerie.

In a pile of rocks overgrown with weeds, Li Chen crouched and walked slowly forward. Even in the daytime, there seemed to be a flash of light in his eyes under his hair.

He carefully scanned the surroundings and did not take it lightly just because it was quiet here. Although he was young and had never been to Gu Cang Mountain, his grandfather Lao Li Tou told him many stories.

Especially about the warrior who entered Gu Cang Mountain to hunt for treasure and lost his life because of being careless.

Since childhood, due to ugly birthmarks and inability to condense inner energy,

He stared intently at a chopstick-thick, cyan-colored vine that was no more than a foot long, with small yellow thorns all over its body.

On its tender green leaves, there are a few drops of dew trembling slightly, which look extremely pleasant under the light from above.

"Green Thorn Vine, a first-grade high-grade elixir, and the main ingredient of a top-grade breath-gathering pill!"

The message of the vines flashed through his mind. Li Chen's career as a medicine slave for more than three years has not been in vain. He carefully scanned the earth and rocks within a certain range around the vines, not missing any trace.

Being able to discover the elixir before others does not depends on his cultivation, but his keen sense of smell from being a medicine slave for many years.

Suddenly, his pupils suddenly shrank, and a circle of strange demonic snakes that seemed to be the same as the surrounding earth and rocks, but were obviously connected into one piece, with a body as thick as a child's forearm and no more than two feet long, came into view.

"Earth-ringed snake, a mid-level first-order monster, heavy on defense, extremely poisonous, and extremely powerful!"

When he discovered the earth-ringed snake, he suddenly swallowed a scarlet snake letter and looked up at Li Chen.

Monsters are naturally bloodthirsty, and their spiritual senses are even more astute. Even though Li Chen did his best according to Professor Lao Li Tou's knowledge, he still lacked experience.

Facing this first-level intermediate monster that even sixth-level warriors were obsessed with, Li Chen retreated a little, but thinking about Lao Li Tou's speed teaching, the snake-like monster's close attack speed was extremely fast. If he retreated a little, he would definitely be bitten by the thunder of the earth-ringed snake.

Although his scalp was numb, there was still excitement in his heart. Li Chen exerted force on his calf, moving like a rabbit, and jumped up with a whooshing sound. His eyes burst out with a frightening light. The inner energy reaching the fifth level in his meridians suddenly surged into his right arm, and he punched the snake's neck fiercely.

That was the key point of the Earth-ringed Snake. Li Chen and Xixin shattered the inner veins in his body with one punch. No matter how strong his vitality was, it was of no avail.

It seemed that it was startled by Li Chen's actions, but after all it was a monster that grew up in a cruel environment. The earth-ringed snake opened its mouth and neighed, and its whole body stretched and bounced up. It actually bypassed the fist peak and bit at the throat like lightning.

Li Chen's pupils suddenly shrank, his fist posture remained unchanged, but he changed his fist into claws. He had already perfected the Tiger Roaring Fist, and his palms could change and contract freely. In addition, he had learned the advanced human-level skill "Rongyang Jue", which was extremely strong and extremely yang, and its lethality was even greater.

Under the blessing of the inner breath, the muscles on the palms of the fingers faintly felt the air waves passing through, and with a snap, they caught the incoming earth snake.

It was as if a rough iron rod had been grasped between its tentacles. The snake was only two feet long and was a little longer than Li Chen's arm. It was caught in the middle and lower part and immediately bit his shoulder.

Li Chen swung his whole arm around, and before it could bite him, it turned rapidly like a windmill, hitting the snake one at a time, and the gravel splashed and banged.

After a full cup of tea, he felt that the strength of the snake's tail around his wrist was loosening. He twisted his body and stepped on the top of his head with his foot.

There was a soft sound and a flash of cold light. A dagger with silver light suddenly appeared in Li Chen's left hand. Enduring the faint pain in his arm, he pinned the snake to the ground and stabbed the small blue-white spot on the back of its neck.

The blade of the blade penetrated the flesh, splashing a trace of sweet and fishy blood. The critically injured terrestrial snake twisted twice and then stopped moving.

A monster comparable to a sixth-level warrior in the Inner Breath Realm could be killed in just two moves. Apart from its low intelligence, it has no other advantages except toxicity and defense. In addition to Li Chen's cultivation techniques and his own extremely strong physique, it is enough to prove that Li Chen's strength at this time is definitely stronger than that of ordinary sixth-level warriors.

At this time, his cultivation level had already broken through to the fifth level after secretly taking the Energy Gathering Pill at night.

It was just that there were so many Xi Gathering Pills that allowed Li Chen to break through to the peak of the fifth level in the past few months of hard training, but it made him a little discouraged.

He gasped for air and had no time to wipe the sweat from his forehead. Li Chen took out a jade bottle from his backpack, pulled out the cork, and turned the snake body upside down.

A stream of dark red snake blood flowed out, exuding heat, and poured into the small jade bottle. Until the snake blood turned red, Li Chen put the snake body down and put it back into the backpack.

After doing this, Li Chen peeled off the snake skin and pulled out the fangs. As for the snake meat, he finally chose to give up. The smell of blood was too strong to avoid being noticed by others.

If others knew that a "waste" like him could hunt down mid-level first-order monsters, it would definitely cause unnecessary trouble.

After being humiliated for many years, I still have this bit of forbearance.

Unfortunately, after pinching the snake corpse, no demon core was found.

He carefully dug out the green thorn vine. Just when he was about to take a rest, he suddenly got up and ran towards a place in the forest.

The figure like a monkey disappeared in the dense forest in an instant.

The harsh sound of the flute came from a distance, one after another. If Li Chen didn't have an amazing ear, he might have missed it, or he might have heard it as the cry of some kind of monster.

Underwear fluttered in the dense forest, and Li Chen kept rushing toward the sound of the flute.

When it reappears, hide in the gap between two boulders and look into the distance.

In the messy bushes, there were seven or eight people with weapons in hand, confronting each other. Judging from their clothes, they were all disciples of Xuanyun Sect, but they were obviously divided into two groups.

In the middle is a dark brown demon pig lying on the ground, fully two meters in size, with blood marks all over its body.

"You people from the East Campus robbed my disciples from the South Campus of their demon cores. Aren't you afraid of being punished by the Master of the Campus?"

Li Chen recognized that the outer disciple named Zhang Futong was only at the fifth level.

Behind him, Zhao Shanshan supported another young man who fell to the ground. There was a shocking pool of blood on his chest. His chest was rising and falling slightly, and he was severely injured.

This person's name is Liu Ziqing. He is the strongest among the three. He is at the sixth level of the Inner Breath Realm, but he doesn't want to be hurt here.

Maybe Li Chen was the closest to this place, but he was the one who got here first.

"What this junior brother said is unacceptable. This is the monster we hunted, so why would we rob it?"

Opposite, a young man with two daggers on his waist casually tossed the demon core the size of a dragon's eye in his hand. It was obvious that the demon pig was a mid-stage demon beast.

A mid-level demon core is comparable to the effectiveness of several mid-level energy gathering pills, and it cannot be more precious to outer disciples.

Zhang Futong was so angry at the other party's shameless words that he lost his momentum and was speechless for a moment.

"Hmph, Lu Hongyang, I think you are itchy. Do you dare to bully my junior brother?"

There was a loud bang, and a fat figure jumped down from the boulder in the distance and rushed towards this place quickly.
